facts.fact: Peter 跳伞伤情盘点：脚踝重扭、肩脱臼、肋骨断、两指骨折——都是跳伞出舱时撞的，短期不能飞
facts.anchor: A dislocated shoulder, broken ribs and two fractured fingers

facts.fact: 他的战前身份：艺术史讲师、专攻 Caravaggio；被派驻瓦莱塔正因大师名画在此
facts.anchor: career as lecturer on the history of art, specialising in the work of Michelangelo Merisi da Caravaggio

facts.fact: 马耳他存活率传闻约两周出头；他已活过一个月；这是他第一场败仗——输给对手的技术而非鲁莽
facts.anchor: this was the first he’d lost

facts.fact: 同事探访带来消息：他的德机对手也被打落、获救，希望这场战争别再飞
facts.anchor: He flew on, then spluttered and dropped his arse into the drink

facts.fact: Maria 护士引 Valentina 进病房；他记得她——「I never forget a kind face」，她红脸
facts.anchor: I never forget a kind face

facts.fact: 她自陈留守看空袭的理由：你在为我的安全而战，我必须看着你活下来
facts.anchor: I needed to watch you survive

facts.fact: 词汇课三连：harried（他递词）/ loner（她认领）/ valens（名字=坚强英勇）
facts.anchor: It comes from the Latin “valens”. It means strong… valiant.

facts.fact: 他追问战后理想，她背完命运剧本后说出梦想：上大学；他惊呼并宣称全世界年轻人都该上大学
facts.anchor: attended university to broaden and enrich their minds

facts.fact: 他自剖婚姻：被 Delia 母亲做局裹挟成婚；飞行里才有自由；被问爱不爱用「爱我们的猫」搪塞——猫是谎言
facts.anchor: The cat was a lie. They had no pets.

facts.fact: Maria 折返警告「别给姑娘灌输思想，这样说下去不会有好结果」；她抛吻逃走
facts.anchor: blowing him a kiss before fleeing his room
